env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A continue across a plain switch inside an exact const switch case runs the same ejected as natively.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cd a
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_nested_jump.lgo main.lgo
logos eject -o out
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_switch_nested_jump.out

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/cswjump

go 1.27
